name: Aaliyah Brooks
about_me: I'm Aaliyah, strategy lead on the Michigan Solar Car team. We race across Australia next year and we lost our battery sponsor. I'm looking for a battery or energy company to sponsor us.
goals: Sign a new battery sponsor for the solar car

debriefs.text: Aisha Bello, our team lead, wants a sponsor signed by January so we can order cells. She said I own outreach with Avery.
Talked to Omar Haddad from GridLeaf at Detroit Hardware Night. He can't give cash but offered to lend test equipment.
Met Lucia Ferraro, Ford recruiter, who said Ford sponsors student teams through a separate foundation office.
Jonah Fischer, the recruiter at Routewise, wants our team's resumes and might sponsor a small amount in exchange.

card.headline: Strategy lead, Michigan Solar Car
card.about: Racing across Australia; need a battery sponsor.
